where: Through the narrow archway, a hidden cathedral of Old Valkara: walls of white marble glowing with a faint inner starlight, pillars carved as ancient oaks branching up into a vault painted with the constellations of a lost sky. At its centre, on a stepped dais in a ring of silver runes, an empty altar, the air above it rippling. Shadows lie behind the altar. The party has just come through the archway with Lady Astrid and Eamon.
